business_summary: Lands' End, Inc. operates as a digital retailer of apparel, swimwear, outerwear, accessories, footwear, home products, and uniforms in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through U.S. eCommerce, Europe eCommerce, Outfitters, Third Party, Licensing, and Retail segments. It also sells uniform and logo apparel to businesses and their employees, and student households; and earns royalties on the use of Lands' End trademark. The company sells its products through its e-commerce websites and company operated stores, as well as through third party distribution channels under the Lands' End, Lands' End Lighthouse, Squall, Tugless Tank, Drifter, Outrigger, Marinac, Wanderweight, Beach Living, Supima, No-Gape, Anyweather, Waveshaper, Starfish, Little Black Suit, Iron Knees, Hyde Park, Year'Rounder, ClassMate, Willis & Geiger, and ThermaCheck brands. Lands' End, Inc. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Dodgeville, Wisconsin.
business_summary_ko: Lands' End, Inc.는 미국, 유럽 및 전 세계에서 의류, 수영복, 겉옷, 액세서리, 신발, 가정용품, 유니폼을 판매하는 디지털 소매업체로 운영되고 있습니다. 이 회사는 미국 전자상거래, 유럽 전자상거래, Outfitters, 제3자, 라이센스 및 소매 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 또한 기업과 직원, 학생 가구에 유니폼과 로고 의류를 판매합니다. Lands'End 상표 사용에 대한 로열티를 받습니다. 회사는 전자 상거래 웹사이트와 회사 운영 매장을 비롯해 Lands' End, Lands' End Lighthouse, Squall, Tugless Tank, Drifter, Outrigger, Marinac, Wanderweight, Beach Living, Supima, No-Gape, Anyweather, Waveshaper, Starfish, Little Black Suit, Iron Knees, Hyde Park, Year'Rounder, ClassMate, Willis & Geiger 등의 제3자 유통 채널을 통해 제품을 판매합니다. ThermaCheck 브랜드. Lands' End, Inc.는 1963년에 설립되었으며 위스콘신주 닷지빌에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
